meta.name: distilly
meta.description: Build and use evidence-grounded local person profiles with Distilly's exact five-tool workflow. Use when a user asks to research, ingest, distill, update, correct, retrieve, or recall a real or fictional person's profile, voice, boundaries, or evidence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立并调用有依据的人物档案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常用到有条理、可复核的人物资料
copy.tagline_en: Build and retrieve evidence-based persona profiles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with structured, verifiable person profiles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为某个真实或虚构人物建立一份可复查的本地档案,每条结论都对应你提供的原文出处,不自行联想补充。以后想查、想加或想改,直接说即可。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 为某个真实或虚构人物建立、调取或修改带证据来源的档案时,该技能会启用。

say.text: 帮我查一下爱丽丝的档案概况。
say.note: Claude 会先确认指代的人,再展示档案摘要。

say.text: 把这份访谈整理进鲍勃的档案里。
say.note: Claude 会原文核对后入档,不自行概括。

say.text: 把刚才关于查理的结论改一下,以这份邮件为准。
say.note: Claude 会依据你的新来源更正,其余不动。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude keeps a reviewable local profile for each real or fictional person you ask about. Each statement is backed by a quoted source you provided; it never adds its own guesses. You can later retrieve, extend, or correct the profile on request.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask to create, retrieve, or revise an evidence-backed profile for a real or fictional person.

say_en.note: Claude resolves the person, then shows the profile.

say_en.text: File this interview under Bob's profile.
say_en.note: It ingests the transcript and traces the claims.

say_en.text: Correct the earlier claim about Charlie using this email.
say_en.note: It applies only the correction you supplied.
